components.gap: Source examples are missing. The notational worked examples are not reproduced: the parenthesis-omission examples on printed p.58 (a_iota b_iotaiota(c_iotaiota d_iota) and its lambda variant, each with its full expansion) and the bracket-precedence example on printed p.59 (~p > q >. pq v rs > ~. q v s > ~p ~r) with its two-stage expansion into primitive notation. Body 132-140 states the conventions only. The selection rule counts examples as part of the presentation. | Source qualifications are missing. Printed p.61 distinguishes formal theorems from syntactical theorems and notes that 'theorem' is used ambiguously; printed p.62 distinguishes the sign |- from the assertion sign of Russell and Frege. Neither appears; body 249-265 gives only the definitions of theorem and proof. Body 39-40 also drops the source's Schoenfinkel attribution for the currying of many-place functions (printed p.57, n.6). | Attributed standing is altered. On printed p.59 the source says the non-definability of the same-type predecessor without descriptions 'follows from the independence of the axiom of infinity (§4)', where the axiom of infinity is Axioms 7 and 8 together (p.61). Body 162-164 instead says 'because Axiom~8 below is independent'. The handbook neither proves the claim nor marks it as a sketched, unproved source claim.
